qualification: A mapping of targeted executable demos, existing tests and explicitly remaining test design; not a claim of exhaustive coverage or acceptance.

items.title: Path-contiguity oracle
items.remaining_test_work: Reject empty/singleton paths; accept each adjacent forward/reverse edge; reject malformed coordinates and disconnected paths.

items.title: Configured Eventness suffixes
items.remaining_test_work: Exercise default, dotted, extension-bearing and overlapping state suffixes; preserve source identity and root isolation.

items.title: CIR empty recorded Eventness
items.remaining_test_work: CIR list reports exactly []; keep WIR recorded states intact.

items.title: Ordinary PR gate and pinned environments
items.remaining_test_work: Add a Julia supported-suite runner with nonzero eligibility, separate pass/fail/error/broken/skip counts and exact exit propagation; exercise failing/empty child fixtures before wiring CI.

items.title: Reproducible Julia and exhaustive Holdem
items.remaining_test_work: Run the explicit Julia executable and report process faults separately; exhaustive five-card oracle remains a distinct gate.

items.title: Fresh inputs and immutable refresh
items.remaining_test_work: Mutate every assessed role, preserve history, then validate a genuinely fresh replacement; no relabeling stale evidence.

items.title: Pure read containment and no execution
items.remaining_test_work: Inside links resolve, outside links reject LANG002; sentinel bindings do not run and inventories remain unchanged; extend to linked roots/configs.

items.title: Complete WIR diagnostic matrix
items.remaining_test_work: Extend existing exact-code tests with RLIR001/008/009/011, version/scope/function/flow/event/Warp cardinality, bundles and aliases; independent source spans.

items.title: Complete CIR diagnostic matrix
items.remaining_test_work: Extend RCIR001/003/004/006/010 cardinality and coordinator identity tests; retain existing ordered await, policy and projection controls.

items.title: Lexical isolation and await policy
items.remaining_test_work: Comments cannot invent declarations; add quoted/escaped braces, malformed tokens, multiline flows and repeated/reordered await cases after documenting exact supported semantics.

items.title: Independent graph oracle
items.remaining_test_work: Exact node/edge/wait/reachability oracle and valid reported cycle edges; extend disjoint/overlapping shortest cycles and AND-readiness boundary.

items.title: Query input/error/projection matrix
items.remaining_test_work: Keep exact exit/schema/hash/ambiguity codes, compact-expanded equivalence, malformed config and excluded-path cases.

items.title: Companion argument combinations
items.remaining_test_work: Invalid confirmation/recovery/ID combinations reject with no mutation; valid checked preview remains pure.

items.title: Conflicting published records
items.remaining_test_work: Both durable records must agree when present; reject malformed prepared records even beside accepted history. Freeze missing-prepared replay policy separately.

items.title: Queried status exact identity
items.remaining_test_work: Reject altered source hash, substituted before/after and omitted assessed inputs; no current acceptance and no actor mutation.

items.title: Legacy containment and rollback
items.remaining_test_work: Add linked legacy lane, occupied status destination, deterministic write failure/rollback and replay tests; legacy replacement policy is separate from checked immutability.

items.title: Parent qualification matrix
items.remaining_test_work: Cross evidence freshness/status, acceptance domain, child state and exact public hash; same shape/different identity and nesting must not inherit acceptance.

items.title: Runtime loader gate and boundaries
items.remaining_test_work: Run every existing case; extend exact +/-1 unique resource limits, growth during read and multi-reason precedence without mutating packets or executing producers.

items.title: Runtime API/browser integration
items.remaining_test_work: Reuse existing Warp order; API allowlist/opt-in/empty compatibility plus browser loading/error/stale/mismatch, responsive views and disk-restart lifecycle. Port Python browser checks before execution.

items.title: Specialist mock-to-real substitution
items.remaining_test_work: Add a bounded producer fixture with identical public contract for mock/real, wrong-worker negative and separate exact-hash parent acceptance.

items.title: Syscall fault injection
items.remaining_test_work: Extend existing stage interruption tests with deterministic partial write/sync/link/unlink/cleanup faults and fresh-process recovery, preserving valid state without false ACK.

items.title: Graph/layer properties and real refresh forks
items.remaining_test_work: Permute layers and duplicate equivalent attempts; conflicts cannot increase coverage. Use correctly named competing successors and verify attribution/narrowed predecessors/reused IDs.

items.title: Limits, IDs, timestamps and hash vectors
items.remaining_test_work: Extend 80/81 ID boundary with 128/129 cases, duplicate JSON keys, timestamp extremes, multi-reason precedence and independent Rust/Julia FNV vectors.

items.title: Spans, negative mutations and Julia types
items.remaining_test_work: Independent UTF-8 source slices, verified single-fault mutations, missing/extra fields, Bool versus Int, aliases/intrinsics/bindings, immutable values and JSON controls.

items.title: Inspector stress and conformance corpus
items.remaining_test_work: Nested malformed data, bounded inventory/time/output/Unicode/navigation failures; version supported Rust/Julia corpus and preserve statically sound but wrong-output negative.

items.title: Coverage, mutations, fuzzing and stress
items.remaining_test_work: Measure only after reproducible gates; seed/minimize SCC and containment/hash/fan-in/exit/resource mutations in a separate bounded slow lane.

items.title: Native platforms and extracted packages
items.remaining_test_work: Current demo only smokes a selected binary directory. Port package content/hash/query/CIR/preview checks to Cargo/Julia and run on extracted Linux/Windows packages; do not execute Python.

items.title: Capability and Eventness guidance
items.remaining_test_work: Add a guidance regression that preserves inspection of overlapping markers; reconcile delivered capability tables and current runtime readiness without deleting markers.

items.title: Trace identifiers and configured roles
items.remaining_test_work: Query each declared full ID and check roles under explicit custom/default keyword fixtures; do not silently overwrite local policy.

items.title: Advanced milestones
items.remaining_test_work: Separate contracts and red-test gates for unified identity, grid, watch readiness, retry/failure, scatter/gather and imports. No invented executable semantics before each contract.

items.title: Requirement-to-evidence ledger
items.remaining_test_work: Catalog test checks every checkbox ID, unique entries, real suite paths, valid slices and executable new case selectors; accepted evidence stays null until qualified.

items.title: Observed gates and checked residue
items.remaining_test_work: Bind revision, binary/test/config/runner hashes, exits, platforms and real gate receipts; rename only completed scope after verification.
